name: カテゴリ全体と個別会話の選択
prompt:
Create the second render of this same compact category and two-channel component. Keep the exact 390x208 canvas ratio, all Japanese wording, font sizes, colors, glyphs and checkbox states from the native preview and v001. This is only a vertical-position correction.

In v001 every content group is about 8-11 logical pixels too low. Raise the category header and follow control about 8px, and raise both channel rows about 10px, keeping their native spacing relative to one another. Do not scale or widen any text or checkbox.

Place the category label 「相談とアイデア」 at x15 y11. At upper right, put the empty 16x16 checkbox at x258 y8 and 「分類をフォロー」 at x282 y11.

First row positions: gray outline # around x24 y65; bold dark 「地域からのお知らせ」 at x64 y59; muted-gray 「5日前に活動」 at x24 y91; forest-green 24x24 selected checkbox at x340 y64 with white check.

Second row positions: gray outline # around x24 y144; bold dark 「活動の相談」 at x64 y138; muted-gray 「地域の活動について相談する場所です。」 at x24 y169; forest-green 24x24 selected checkbox at x340 y143 with white check. Keep 14px channel titles and 12px secondary labels on the logical canvas.

No hyperlink text appears in this component. Category and channel names are labels/selection targets, not links, so keep them dark. If any real hyperlink label is present, linked words must be blue. Do not recolor forest-green selected checkboxes. Preserve the plain white background and omit dividers, cards, shadows, extra rows, emoji and badges.

Use the native preview as exact authority for positions, text, size and color. Use v001 only as a visual style reference and correct its downward shift.
reviewNotes: v002を実画像で目視。日本語全ラベル、説明文、2つの選択チェックと空の分類チェックを保持。リンク文言なし。v001の下寄りは改善し比率もnativeに一致。カテゴリ見出しは少し低く、2行目と説明文はnativeより高めに見える。右側の分類/選択コントロールも少し右寄り。2回の限定試行後、残差をneeds-correctionとして記録。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: Primary Japanese native preview: exact 390x208 category and two selected channel rows
